reason: I'd use the free 30 to see if it catches anything, but I'm not paying for a new bot from people I've never heard of that sits in my work group. Half of what I pay out is cash to mechanics with scrappy handwritten slips, and I need to see it handle those first.
objection: Catching duplicates is nice, but the guy who burned me didn't send the same receipt twice, he wrote a bigger number. A bot that checks the totals add up won't catch a mechanic who inflates his price. And will this tiny bot still be running in a year, or will I be back to scrolling Telegram?
would_change_my_mind: If during the free 30 it flags a real duplicate or a padded receipt that I missed myself, I'd pay the $19 without thinking about it.
